ipc.title: Punishment for murder
ipc.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

ipc.title: Punishment for rape
ipc.text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of  either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years.

ipc.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives
ipc.text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

ipc.title: Cheating
ipc.text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years.

crpc.title: Information in cognizable cases
crpc.text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him.

crpc.title: Notice of appearance before police officer
crpc.text: The police officer shall, in all cases where the arrest of a person is not required, issue a notice directing the person to appear before him.

iea.title: Admissibility of electronic records
iea.text: Any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper shall be deemed to be also a document.

iea.title: Interpretation clause
iea.text: In this Act the following words and expressions are used in the following senses.

bns.title: Punishment for murder
bns.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

bns.title: Punishment for rape
bns.text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than ten years.

bns.title: Cheating
bns.text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years.

bns.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
bns.text: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

bnss.title: Information in cognizable cases
bnss.text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing by him.

bnss.title: When police may arrest without warrant
bnss.text: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest any person who commits a cognizable offence in his presence.

bsa.title: Admissibility of electronic records
bsa.text: Any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on paper shall be deemed to be also a document.
